description: Source code for generating and manipulating JFFS2 on-disk structures for MTD flash memory devices, including functions for creating directories, files, and parsing JFFS2 data.

methods.name: prep_eraseblock
methods.description: Prepares an erase block for writing, handling bad blocks and erasing as needed.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the buffer to align with the specified size, erasing and writing blocks as necessary.

methods.name: add_dirent
methods.description: Adds a directory entry with specified name, type, and parent inode.

methods.name: add_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory inode and associated directory entry.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a file and its data to the JFFS2 structure, reading from the filesystem.
